title: Reachable cities in two hops
statementMd:
Starting from LHR, list the destinations reachable with at most 2 flights (ignoring dates) together with the minimum number of hops. Order by hops then airport code.

Expected columns: `code`, `hops`.

Tables: `airlines`, `airports`, `flights`, `bookings`.

**Row order matters** for this problem.
hints: Recursive CTE over distinct routes; take `MIN(hops)`.
solutionMd:
```sql
WITH RECURSIVE routes AS (SELECT DISTINCT origin, destination FROM flights), reach(code, hops) AS (SELECT destination, 1 FROM routes WHERE origin = 'LHR' UNION ALL SELECT r.destination, reach.hops + 1 FROM reach JOIN routes r ON r.origin = reach.code WHERE reach.hops < 2) SELECT code, MIN(hops) AS hops FROM reach WHERE code <> 'LHR' GROUP BY code ORDER BY hops, code;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
